responses.text: You must be the stranger I've been hearing about. Sorry, but I'm strictly forbidden from offering our tech to outsiders like yourself.
Besides, I'm a little busy right now.
Sorry, outsider, but I'm not allowed to sell you anything without the Elder's say so.
Besides, I'm a little busy right now.
I can't believe Hardin is Elder now. At least with the lockdown lifted I'll be able to resupply my store more often. So what are you here for?
Have you heard the news? Elder McNamara has lifted the lockdown! Good news for this store, let me tell you. I can't wait to start getting more goods.
So what are you here for?
The word came down from the Elder that I'm to offer you some of our lesser wares, as if I didn't have other matters on my mind.
Have you found it? I need to give my report to Hardin soon.
Hi there. Looking to spend some caps?
You again? Didn't I tell you I was busy?
Oh thank god. Hardin was about to start an inquiry into the whole affair, and more than a few heads would have rolled as a result.
Since you helped me, I'll tell you what. I work on some of our busted weapons in my spare time, so I have a few pieces that are kept off the books.
Here, take this. I hope it comes in handy.
Then we have nothing further to talk about.

topics.prompt: Sorry, I haven't found it yet.

responses.text: Our patrols are always bringing more stuff in. Take a look.

topics.prompt: Show me what you have for sale.

responses.text: If you happen to find it, bring it here right away. I might be able to throw a few supplies your way if you do.

topics.prompt: I could look around for the pistol.

responses.text: If you must know, my inventory check this week shows that our weapon count is one short. Somehow we're missing a laser pistol.
Hardin will have my head if I don't find that weapon soon. I can't delay my report to him any longer.

topics.prompt: Anything I can help you with?

responses.text: Can't complain. Not like there's anywhere else to go, right?
With everyone getting to go to the surface, I'm a little jealous, but I'll be fine.
